title: get_inventory_api_should_return_filtered_product_list
description: Test the GET /api/inventory endpoint to verify it returns the correct list of products filtered by occasion and includes all necessary product details such as features, pricing, and preview media.

title: post_shipping_rates_api_should_return_correct_courier_rates
description: Test the POST /api/shipping/rates endpoint to ensure it calculates and returns accurate shipping rates based on the selected province and city in Indonesia.

title: post_checkout_api_should_process_order_and_payment
description: Test the POST /api/checkout endpoint to verify it processes the complete checkout flow including digital experience selection, sender and recipient information, shipping details, and payment completion.

title: get_order_status_api_should_return_order_and_courier_tracking_info
description: Test the GET /api/order-status endpoint to confirm it returns real-time order status including payment confirmation, digital gift studio access, and courier delivery tracking information.

title: get_admin_orders_api_should_return_paginated_order_list_for_authorized_admin
description: Test the GET /api/admin/orders endpoint to ensure authorized admins can retrieve a paginated, searchable, and filterable list of digital and physical orders.

title: post_shipping_dispatch_api_should_trigger_courier_dispatch
description: Test the POST /api/shipping/dispatch endpoint to verify that authorized admins can trigger courier dispatch for shipments successfully.

title: post_admin_update_resi_api_should_update_tracking_number
description: Test the POST /api/admin/update-resi endpoint to confirm authorized admins can update the resi tracking number for orders and that the update is reflected correctly.
